cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)

# simplify variable expansion
cmake_policy(SET CMP0053 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0010 NEW)

project(pckcs11 NONE)

set(GIT_CONFIG_OPTIONS "" CACHE STRING "Git configuration options to pass when cloning the project")

include(ExternalProject)

ExternalProject_Add(pkcs11
#   PREFIX pkcs11
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/oasis-tcs/pkcs11.git
  GIT_TAG d8240e4497c26
  GIT_CONFIG ${GIT_CONFIG_OPTIONS}
  SOURCE_DIR src
  CONFIGURE_COMMAND ""
  BUILD_COMMAND ""
  INSTALL_COMMAND ""
  BUILD_ALWAYS 1
  )
